title: PBE0 RPA export used exchange coefficient 1 instead of 0.25 (not restored after RPA run)
symptom: Uniform-grid vs band-path Vxc differ by ~27.77 eV on the same occupied state, and DeltaVxc ~ 0.75*Sigmax hints a missing 0.25 weight; PBE0+GW grid and path outputs disagree at shared k points.
root_cause: ABACUS temporarily set the PBE0 exchange coefficient 0.25 to 1 while generating RPA data and never restored it; the band-path NSCF was unaffected.
minimal_fix: Fix the export path to apply the 0.25 exchange coefficient (or restore it after the RPA export); regenerate the grid Vxc. After the fix the Gamma state-29 EXX contribution returned to -0.72365 eV from +27.04951 eV.
validation: Si control: the RPA switch changed Vxc by 13.04 eV with the bug and by 0.0125 meV after the fix. Re-run GW and require mesh/path shared-k agreement (MnF2: max 1.18 meV).
avoid: Declaring a PBE0+GW run correct from the near-gap window only; high-state discrepancies remained open after this fix.

parameters.check: grid vs path Vxc agree at shared k (0.25 coefficient)
